evidence: Atomic Force Microscopy (AFM) observations are carried out to characterise the surface roughness. X-ray Photoemission Spectroscopy (XPS, monochromatic Al Kα source, 1486.6 eV) is employed to study the material composition and chemistry and detect possible contaminants. Current –Voltage (I –V) and Capacitance –Voltage (C –V) curves are recorded on MOS structures ... XRD to be amorphous, and to maintain the amorphous character up to 800 °C.
